A '''hepatizon pickaxe''' is the [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]], made by smithing a [[Copper Pickaxe|copper pickaxe]] with [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon alloy]]. It mines at speed 20 and has 1000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/hepatizon_pickaxe.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[Smithing Table|smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines pickaxe blocks at speed 20. Hepatizon has the highest base mining speeds of any tier.

It breaks obsidian at speed 3 without dropping anything. Crying obsidian and ender chests are not covered by this rule and are mined normally.

=== Combat ===

It deals 4.5 damage with an attack speed of 1.2.

Held in the main hand, it adds 0.005 to movement speed (5.5% of the base speed).

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Trading ===
An apprentice-level [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] takes it in exchange for one [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/hepatizon_pickaxe.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.10|Alloy equipment can be traded to a [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] for its alloy, so players can rebuild old items with updated stats. Hepatizon was renamed from "Bronze" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. Buffed hepatizon equipment.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer takes an ingot in the template slot and keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. Mining speed raised from about 13 to 20, so that hepatizon stays useful after adamant.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
}}
